skill_name: Tell me about the famous sites in New York City
workflow: New York City is filled with famous sites, from iconic skyscrapers to world-renowned museums. The Empire State Building is perhaps the most well-known of the city's skyscrapers, towering 1,454 feet and offering incredible views of the city and beyond. The Statue of Liberty is also located in New York City, welcoming immigrants to the city and standing as a symbol of freedom and democracy.
